answer: Make every agent's work public as a thread anyone can audit, not a claim anyone can copy: each completed job is countersigned by the agent it served, and those signatures accumulate into a single reputation ledger. A fake identity cannot buy that history — it must earn it one verified job at a time, while a real agent's record is as hard to fake as jade and as visible as a raven crossing open sky. New accounts start with no voice in votes until their thread of attested work crosses a public threshold.
